comparison.objective: Select washable blender parts and load them into a dishwasher while excluding the motor base.
comparison.physical_skill: Object classification, pick-and-place, support, and release versus precise tool engagement and iterative mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Jug and lid released stably in the rack, with any motor entry vetoing success, versus bounded repeated carriage impacts.
comparison.reason: The record deliberately fixes the door and rack and does not score orientation, so it tests safe component selection/loading rather than dexterous commissioning. No spec versions exist.
